title: Inertia of a pair bound through the field

key_results.statement: In the sector $P$ (body 1 as representative, continued to real $P$) the band contract at order $\tau^2$ is the relative chain $h_P$ with bond amplitudes $t(\rho;P)=\kappa_1(\rho)e^{-2iP}+\kappa_2(\rho)$; $r$ even and $r$ odd form separate rings.
At leading order in $\varepsilon$, $M^{(2)}(r)=-2ng_1g_2\ell(r)/t_f$ and the relative potential is $V(r)=\frac{ng_1g_2}{t_fL}r(L-r)$: a well at contact for $g_1g_2>0$, a hill for $g_1g_2<0$.

Under R and B, for every branch combination and both signs of $\gamma_1\gamma_2$, bound levels exist: the lowest relative levels if $\sigma_1\sigma_2\gamma_1\gamma_2>0$, the highest if $<0$; they are made of bodies near rest iff $g_1g_2(\mu_1^{-1}+\mu_2^{-1})>0$.

open_issues: At finite L the curvature at P=0 depends on the continuation in P through the ring term of (6.6) (12% at L=12, 3% at L=16 in set A); only the line value is a property of the bound level.
The closed forms (6.2), (6.4), (6.15) use the second-order mutual term; at η≈0.3 the exact binding slope is about half of F; statements in terms of β_ν, b_ν and M are unaffected.
The O(ε³) remainder of (6.7) is large at moderate couplings (ratio 1.40 for (a), −0.19 for (c) at η≈0.3), so the mark part is reliable only for small η.
The O(ε) correction of (6.14) from the second-order weights is not evaluated (the bond function B of (4.7) is not quoted); in the code it is 13–16%.
In tight binding of the even class β_0∼1/χ and B3 fails when χ ≳ δ_1δ/τ'²; the order-τ⁴ band contract is then needed.
R1 for σ_i=+1 bounds t_f by (2M_i−δ_1)/(4N_f), restrictive for many field objects; whether weak resonances with multiply excited field states can be tolerated is open.
Out of scope: full grip, tori, highest field state, bodies of one type, the speed of a front of the field, and how typical the structure is.

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions of μ_i, m, 1/E_b'', M̄/c², μ_1μ_2K_ν (inverse cost) and of Π (cost)
Unbound limit χ→0 on the line: β_0→1 and 1/E_b''→μ_1+μ_2, equal to the curvature of E_1(p_1)+E_2(p_2) minimized at fixed p_1+p_2
Tight binding χ→∞: even class E_b''≈8κ̄_1κ̄_2/F and odd class 1/E_b''=2(μ_1+μ_2), equal to direct perturbation of the contact states
